title: pvXdmf3ReaderT
body:
## pvXdmf3ReaderT

Reads XDMF 3 files (.xmf/.xdmf) with heavy data in HDF5. A single domain with one grid gives that dataset type; otherwise the output is a multiblock. This variant treats a series of files as successive time steps (AsTime true by default). Point and cell arrays and named sets can be selected. Use pvXdmf3ReaderS for the other file-series interpretation and pvXDMFReader for XDMF 2 files.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The HDF5 files must stay where the XML references them.
- Array and set selections start from ParaView's choice; list them when later steps depend on particular names.
- Schemaxis generates this reader binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check with a sample file of this format.

Native constructor: `Xdmf3ReaderT`. Identity: `sources/Xdmf3ReaderT`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AsTime` | This hidden property controls whether the reader should treat a file series as a temporal or spatial partitioning. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CellArrays` | This property lists which cell-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrays` | This property lists which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Sets` | Select the sets to be loaded from the dataset, if any. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvXdmf3ReaderT",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
